A's GET and PUT on B's sales.invoice sequence get 404, and B's row is unchanged (same prefix and version). Filters and searches on B's company ids and codes (GSF-SHJ, GSF-RAK) return 0 B rows. biggest_gap.title: Still no green full verify: three p00 gate tests on the audit log and the HTTP attack self-test failed in a quiet alone run, though p10's own surface held everywhere
biggest_gap.detail: p10 is ready on its own merits. The configure-sequence comparison is a clear win (6 steps and 13 keys against 17 and 32; 12 s against 41 s modelled). Yearly and monthly reset with a live preview works by keyboard in English and Arabic. Every hand attack and every effective plant on p10's surface was refused or caught. All p10 gates passed in the full run. But a round needs one full passing ./erp verify, and my alone verify of 5ad2cb51 (load mean 5.4) failed 3 of 1,003 .NET tests, all outside p10. (1) G1CompanyIsolationTests flags GET /api/audit/log?take=20002 as telling company Y's PO box apart. On the demo, take=20002 and take=30017 give byte-identical answers (126,744 bytes, total 740,567) when nothing writes in between. So this looks like the audit log moving under parallel gate writes, not a leak. (2) G1ListVolumeTests: 25 /api/audit/log?filter=fields eq '<field>' answers were not 200, even with a6bcedcd (GIN overlap) in the tree. On the demo the same requests answer 200 in 0.1 to 1.7 s at load 75. (3) GateSelfTests' HTTP attack missed the planted /api/leaky/lookup?email= leak. The same code passed all 2,381 tests in p09's critic's run of 17ba3338, so these gates are nondeterministic. Until p00 makes them deterministic (or an integrator's alone run comes out green), p10 cannot get a clean round. No p10 change can fix this.
biggest_gap.evidence: verify-kept/20261111T222900Z-296539/dotnet-suite.log lines ~898-910 (company isolation oracle) and ~1153-1216 (list volume, 25 audit-log answers). verify-kept/20261111T222900Z-296539/dotnet-self-http.log lines 7-56 ('Assert.Contains() Failure' at GateSelfTests.cs:149; no 'leaks on /api/leaky/lookup' line). verify-load-samples has mean 5.4 and peak 35.6. probe-audit-filter.txt reproduces the same requests on the demo: all 200, and the take=20002 vs take=30017 bodies are identical. human_gates.what: p10 enforces the VAT tax-document numbering rules from docs/compliance/vat-tax-document-numbering.md, which the owner signed off in decision #32. Tax invoice and credit note sequences are always gapless, given numbers are append-only (the app role has no UPDATE or DELETE), and a pattern change that could repeat a number is refused. Any further change to these rules goes back to the owner.
